summary: FangDD Network Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq notification for non-compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company's Class A ordinary shares closed below $1 per share for 30 consecutive business days through July 21, 2026. A 180-day compliance period, until January 19, 2027, has been granted; compliance requires closing bid price of at least $1 for ten consecutive business days. This is a routine regulatory notification with no special situation or transaction involved.
